class_guess: Base-4 counter: fixed 4-phase digit words in a 100 sea; births at the right end, a zero-field cluster at the left wall
summary: Exact base-4 counter on fixed digit words in a 100 sea; both starts follow one rule set; no halt to 1e16.
mechanism: At every D-record the tape is 0^inf [1100] P(p1) s^f1 ... P(pk) s^R 100 D> 0^inf, s = 100, digit words P0 = 11001100, P1 = 110000, P2 = 1001100, P3 = 10000. One sweep adds 1 from the right: 3s wrap to 0 (moving 2 cells left), the first lower digit steps up in place. Fields follow from positions; R grows 6 per 4 sweeps.

Fields shrink 2 per cycle of their left digit and die; a digit whose field is 0 is pushed one word right instead of overlapping, so the oldest digits form a zero-field cluster at the left and keep counting. Overflows alternate the wall 1100 / none; every other one gives birth to a new digit P3 at the right end.

Lines 274 and 514 (start F, mirrored) enter the same language by step 108 / 792 and differ only in one field (+4). Exact sweep simulator (rules + step formula) = C core at 1e11 on both; no halt to 1e16 on either.

rules.name: R1 increment
rules.cases: p = 0, 1, 2; the digit stays in place

rules.name: R2 carry
rules.steps: 8(R + fields crossed) + 52 per wrapping digit + 32 or 76 (stop digit q = 1) + 20 per push word
rules.cases: each wrapped digit moves 2 cells left and its right field loses 1; q = 1 also costs its right field 1

rules.name: PUSH (zero field)
rules.from: P(a) s^0 P(b) with the field due to go to -1
rules.to: P(a') s^0 P(b') with P(b') one word further right; its right field pays 1
rules.cases: cascades through runs of zero fields

rules.name: O2 overflow, wall + birth
rules.to: 0^inf 1100 P(0)...P(0) s^R' P(3) s^2 100 D>  (every digit 2 more cells left)
rules.cases: k digits, any fields; R' = R + 1 - push words

template.diff: W = 100 here; digit words of 8/6/7/5 cells; wraps shift 2 cells; zero-field pushes; O2 extra pass
template.note: Same take/give/carry digit-counter shape with fixed-size digit words, but the 2-cell wrap shift needs a re-cut of the words, the Sk1 batch rule excludes zero-field pushes, and the O2 overflow adds a full extra pass. Closest own kills: #30/#7 counter route; W7-4 shares the sea and the wall/birth cycle but not the digit law.

strategy: One closed-language proof: sea-crossing lemmas, 4-phase digit lemmas (stop/wrap), a push lemma by induction over zero-field runs, the two overflow lemmas, and an invariant giving R >= 2k+2 at every O2; then entry lemmas for 274 (108 steps) and 514 (792 steps).
risks: The push cascade and O2's extra pass need inductive segment lemmas; that is new formal work beyond Sk1CounterMixed.
The domain condition (room at O2) counts, so a pure regular-language certificate is unlikely without extra structure.
Scoop risk: Skelet 1-like Class 1 is mxdys's mined class (Sk1Machines.v TM1..TM105 list).
